submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2.5 mm gas gap is recommended as it achieves the best possible time resolution (1.952 ns) while meeting all project constraints. This is the ONLY environmentally compliant mixture that satisfies the hard GWP100 ≤ 150 requirement mandated by laboratory environmental policy. Systematic gas gap optimization across the full 1-3 mm range identified 2.5 mm as the optimal configuration, providing 21.1% better resolution than 1.0 mm, 4.3% better than 2.0 mm, and 13.2% better than 3.0 mm gaps. While Mixtures G1 and G2 would offer superior time resolution (1.3 ns and 0.875 ns respectively at 2 mm), they are both eliminated due to non-compliance with the environmental constraint. The recommended configuration represents the optimal balance between detector performance and mandatory environmental compliance, achieving the best time resolution possible within the given constraints.
